# `aitbc agent-wallet rebalance`

Rebalance an agent wallet by reinvesting the specified earnings.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent-wallet rebalance [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-id` | text | — | yes | Agent ID. |
| `--earnings` | text | `0` | no | Earnings to reinvest |
| `--reinvest-pct` | text | `50` | no | Percentage of earnings to reinvest |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent-wallet rebalance --agent-id <agent_id>
```
